summary: Fully derived the Formats/Latest class-dictionary grammar bottom-up and built src/rvt/schema_a.py, which parses the stream with zero gaps for [0x00000, 0x21e61) — 138,849 bytes, 1,150 class definitions (727 top-level + 423 inline), 3,111 fields, type ids 0x0c–0x489, 877 backward u16 type refs with 0 unresolved — then stops with a precise desync report because the remaining 72% of the inflated blob (0x21e61–EOF) is intrinsically corrupted data (mangled identifiers, letter runs, misaligned framing) that Revit 2026 itself wrote: proven byte-identical across all six files, contiguous CFB sectors, and identical output from two independent inflate implementations (zlib -15 and inflate64). Grammar: class_record = u16 0 + u16 nameLen + name + u16 parentRef (0x8000|id ⇒ inline parent definition) + u32 version + u32 fieldCount + fields + u32 guidCount + 16-byte GUIDs; field = u32 nameLen + name + 4-byte tag (kind, flags, u16 0) + [u32 count if flags high nibble 1] + [u16 typeRef if kind 0x0e and value-flavour; 0x8000 ⇒ inline class definition] + [anonymous element sub-field + trailing typeRef for kind 0x0d arrays]. Type ids are assigned by definition order starting at 0x0c; inheritance is encoded (698/1150 have parents; Element is the top base). ADocument (version 2662, 19 fields, 1,509-GUID trailer) maps onto the Global/* streams. Wrote schema_a.json + schema_a_meta.json, the spec doc with four hex-annotated worked examples, and an inbox note.
key_findings: Formats__Latest.gz/000.bin sha256 36c6ea9711ced9ee... is identical in all six files (498,766 bytes); it is a per-build constant class dictionary.

Class record grammar (LE): u16 zero prefix, u16 nameLen + ASCII name, u16 parentRef (0 = none, 0x8000|id = parent class defined inline immediately, else backward ref), u32 version, u32 fieldCount, fields[], u32 guidCount + guidCount×16-byte GUID table (usually 0; ADocument 1509, AUnits 13, Element 2, 26 classes total).

Field grammar: u32 nameLen + name + 4-byte tag = kind, flags, u16 pad(0); flags high-nibble 0x1 (0x10/0x11) ⇒ u32 array count; kind 0x0e (class) with value-flavoured flags (low nibble 0: 0x00/0x50/0x10) ⇒ u16 typeRef where 0x8000|id means the referenced class is defined inline right there (recursively); pointer flavours 0x01/0x02/0x03/0x51 carry no static type; kind 0x0d = inline array whose element is an anonymous sub-field named " ", followed by a repeated u16 typeRef when the element is class-typed.

Type ids are definition-order + 0x0c: every class definition (top-level or inline) takes the next id; all 877 plain u16 refs resolve backward (A3PartyObject=0x0d, ElementId=0x14, AppInfo=0x1b, Element=0x25); ids <0x0c are the primitive kind codes (01 bool, 02 byte?, 03 uint16?, 04 int32, 05 uint32, 06 float, 07 double, 08 AString (flags 0x60), 09 GUID, 0a class-def-ref?, 0b int64, 0d inline-array, 0e class).

Container/template types are real inline-defined classes named by their C++ template string (std::pair< ElementId, int > with fields 'first'/'second'); nesting to depth 6; most-referenced types: ElementId 615, XYZ 54, Trf 21, GUIDvalue 16, std::pair< ElementId, int > 10, AStringWrapper 10, std::pair< ElementId, ElementId > 9, ForgeTypeId 8, GeomRef 7, EndInfo 6, std::pair< int, int > 6, EpisodeId 6, RepeaterCoordinates 6, FormatOptions 5, std::pair< int, ElementId > 5, std::pair< ElementId, RbsOffsetSetWrapper > 4, ForeignElemRef 4, NumberingParameter 4, std::pair< ElementId, ElectricalPerPhaseData > 4, ParamStorage 4.

Inheritance IS encoded via parentRef: 698 of 1150 classes have a parent (180 inline-defined, 518 by id); top bases Element 89, GeomStep 63, Cell 54, AppInfo 32, Symbol 27; ADocument (v2662, 19 fields) confirms the Global/* mapping (m_elemTable, m_oContentTable, m_pHistory, m_pPartitionTable as owned pointers) and Element (v21, 20 fields: m_id/m_famId/m_assocLevelId… all ElementId) is the universal base.

The parser CANNOT reach EOF: from 0x21e61 (field 4 of DDGraphSerializable, id 0x48a) the inflated bytes are intrinsically corrupted (0 letter-runs/KB before vs 11.3 after, printable ratio 0.549→0.753, mangled names like 'temFa_idLoa'/'CutoutSkk'/'Templegore'); this is in Revit's own payload — verified by identical decode from zlib raw-inflate and independent inflate64, clean deflate EOF at raw offset 182,241, contiguous OLE sectors, and byte-identity across all six files; ~3,000+ later class definitions (Wall/Level/View classes) are unrecoverable from this release's schema stream.
confidence: High for the record grammar, tag/kind/flag decoding, type-id assignment (877/877 references resolve, all descriptor pads zero, ADocument's 1509×16-byte GUID table fits to the byte) and the ADocument↔Global streams mapping. High that bytes beyond 0x21e61 are corrupted in the payload itself (multiple independent forensics). Medium/[hypothesis] for exact widths of primitive kinds 0x02/0x03/0x05/0x0a, pointer-flavour semantics (0x01 vs 0x02 vs 0x03), the meaning of the per-class GUID tables and class 'version', and the root cause of the tail corruption.
open_questions: Root cause and true extent of the corruption of the inflated schema from 0x21e61 to EOF (72% of the blob); is another Revit release's Formats/Latest intact so the known grammar can decode the remaining ~3,000+ classes?
Exact primitive widths/meanings of kind codes 0x02 (byte?), 0x03 (uint16?), 0x05 (uint32), 0x0a (ClassDefinitionRef.m_ref), and never-seen 0x0c.
Semantics of pointer flavours 0x01/0x02/0x03 and 0x51 (owned vs weak vs raw) and of the container flag distinction 0x50 vs 0x51.
Meaning of the per-class trailing GUID tables (26 classes; ADocument's 1,509 GUIDs with an all-zero entry[1]) and of the u32 class version (ADocument = 2662).

The 712-byte post-deflate trailer on the raw Formats/Latest stream (16 22 85 26 d5 93 07 00, 412 zeros, ~280 high-entropy bytes) — not a gzip trailer, CRC32, or Adler32 of the payload; handed to docs/inbox for the compression slice.

Whether serialized object data in Global/*/Partitions references classes by these numeric type ids (definition order + 0x0c), which would make the recovered id→name table for ids 0x0c–0x48a directly usable by object decoders.
next_steps: Obtain Formats/Latest from a different Revit release (2024/2025) or any file whose schema blob is intact and run src/rvt/schema_a.py on it — the grammar is release-independent and should decode all classes to EOF.

Merge docs/inbox/schema-a.md into KNOWLEDGE.md, especially the warning that class layouts defined after DDGraphSerializable are unavailable from this release's schema, and the intact ADocument/Element/ElementId keystone layouts.
Have the Global/Latest object-graph agent test whether serialized instances reference classes by the numeric type ids (0x0c…) recovered here, using schema_a.json as the id→class lookup.
Cross-check kind-width hypotheses (0x02/0x03/0x05/0x0b) against actual serialized values in Global/ElemTable or Global/Latest once an object decoder exists.
Investigate the 712-byte raw-stream trailer alongside the other streams' trailers (possible chunk index/signature) in the compression slice.
